answer.method_summary: Prospective item-bound policy: call score_variant_fm once successfully for every supplied candidate. Rank ESM-2 delta log-probability and IF1 backbone-conditioned mean log-likelihood separately in the higher-is-better direction, then order by their equal-weight mean rank. Trigger an item-bound classical check only for exact FM aggregate ties near the cutoff (FM ranks 7-20) or strong FM disagreement (absolute component-rank gap at least 50); use BLOSUM62 only to break an exact aggregate tie when all tied candidates have that check, then smaller worst component rank and mutant lexicographic order for determinism. The classical checks here are shallow and mostly invariant, so otherwise they are diagnostic only. These are generic sequence/backbone/evolutionary plausibility signals, not measured cDNA-display-proteolysis ddG_ML_float outcomes, and the mechanistic mismatch means the ranking is hypothesis-level rather than a causal stability-assay model.
